Pharmacokinetics

Mechanism of Action 1

Block NaCl transporter in the proximal DCT

Mechanism of Action 2

Increase PGE2 and PGI2 but not to the same degree as loop diuretics

Therapeutic Uses 1

Hypertension

Therapeutic Uses 2

Heart failure

Therapeutic Uses 3

Hypercalciuria

Therapeutic Uses 4

Diabetes Insipidus

Adverse Effects 1

Potassium depletion

Hyponatremia

Volume depletion

Hypokalemic Metabolic alkalosis

Adverse Effects 2

Hyperuricemia

Adverse Effects 3

Hypercalcemia

Adverse Effects 4

Hyperglycemia and altered lipid metabolism

Adverse Effects 5

Hypersensitivity
